name: AIRDWELLER
summary: Two boxes, one in each hand. Swing for synthesized drums, drag a hit to bend it, tilt for notes, or strike a ringing material tuned to the other hand's kick.
author: willbearfruits
hardware_note: Made for two boards, one in each hand, linked by radio; one board alone plays a mixed kit. Swing the board on a short arm: the stroke detector wants a fast turn and a jolt.
status_note: 0.1 ran on two boards (16 % CPU, 127 KB free). 0.2 (a new detector on the gyro at 1 kHz, the drag, NOTES, SHAPE, EASY) passes the simulator (218 checks) and has not been on a board.
